newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Dec 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Dec 26.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories on December 26:
WASHINGTON - While scarcely a retailer was stirring on Christmas Day, cash registers at the area's 480 7-Eleven convenience stores were jingling like the bells of Santa's reindeer.
NEW YORK - Reunion tour by Kiss topped the 1996 concert draws, taking in $43.6 million.
WASHINGTON - The returns and exchange desks at department stores and other retailers are always a madhouse after Christmas, but they're expected to be even crazier this year.
